provenance.exact_claim_text: A multi-component intervention improves an outcome relative to a comparator.

evidence.text: Source 1 reports a baseline quantity favorable to the intervention.
Source 2 reports no significant change in the primary biomarker (a materially relevant qualifying result).
Inspektorium combines the source-reported inputs with a documented simplified model to estimate an aggregate effect.
evidence.derivation_note: Modelled estimate under model M. Not a value reported by any cited source.

negative_assertions.proposition: No direct head-to-head comparison of the intervention and the comparator was identified.

findings.proposition: The improvement claim is not directly established; the evidence is mixed and partly rests on an Inspektorium modelled estimate.
findings.verdict_summary: A favorable source-reported input (E1) sits alongside a qualifying null result (E2); the aggregate effect (D1) is an Inspektorium estimate. A documented search identified no direct head-to-head comparison.

client_findings.display_claim: The improvement claim is not directly established; the sources give mixed results and the aggregate figure is an Inspektorium estimate.
client_findings.client_explanation: One source reports a favorable baseline; another reports no significant change in the primary biomarker. The aggregate effect is an Inspektorium modelled estimate, not a value published by any source, and a documented search found no direct head-to-head study.
